findings.summary: Dramawebben document kinds are declared only as a type union while runtime validators duplicate the same literals.
findings.consequence: Adding another managed Dramawebben document can compile after updating this union while direct runtime validators in the page, API route, and server utility still reject or fail to map the new kind until each duplicate literal list is found and updated.
findings.evidence: The owned union is `"om" | "kringtexter"` on line 3. The same domain set is repeated in app/pages/dramawebben/[document].vue lines 23-25, server/api/dramawebben/documents/[document].get.ts lines 20-23, and server/utils/dramawebben-document.ts lines 56-58, with a separate source registry in server/utils/dramawebben-document.ts lines 36-39.
findings.recommendation: Export a single const registry or tuple from shared/types/dramawebben-document.ts, derive DramawebbenDocumentKind from it, and reuse a shared isDramawebbenDocumentKind guard at the route/page/server boundaries.
